'''Tao''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], his forces landed on the Imperial-occupied [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and attempted to stage an assault on the [[Sundari Flatlands]] area where the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] was located. However, their effort was thwarted by the Empire, and Tao was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fighting.
